args.title: Fix password reset email link to use correct base URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Update the password reset email template to use the correct base URL instead of defaulting to "http://localhost:3000". This change ensures that the reset-password link in the email points to the actual deployed environment's public URL, preventing users from receiving links to localhost.
